chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about the crucified one: does the punishment of the grave reach him? So he said:
"Indeed, the Lord of the earth is the Lord of the air, so Allah, Mighty and Majestic, commands the air, and it presses upon him more severely than the pressing of the grave."

key_terms.ضَغْطَةِ الْقَبْرِ: the squeezing or constriction of the grave
key_terms.عَذَابُ الْقَبْرِ: the punishment or torment associated with the grave in the intermediate realm

ai.seo_question: How can a crucified person experience the punishment of the grave if he is not buried?
ai.summary: This hadith explains that the realities of barzakh and the punishment of the grave are not restricted to physical burial in the earth. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that Allah, Who is Lord of both earth and air, can cause the crucified person to experience a constriction even without being placed in a grave.
